annotation.title_en: Technology and Artificial Intelligence - Artificial Intelligence in the State of Qatar
annotation.authors_or_issuer: International Media Office, State of Qatar
annotation.summary_en: Qatar government media office web page presenting the country's AI posture: national AI strategy with six pillars, the 2021 AI Committee, Digital Agenda 2030, big-tech partnerships, strategic investments, smart-city applications and a brief statement on ethical, human-centred AI. No robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: National AI Strategy built on six pillars: education, data access, employment, business, research, ethics.
AI Committee established in 2021 under the Ministry of Communications and IT.
QAR 9 billion allocated as incentives for AI, technology and innovation programmes.
Digital Agenda 2030 targets 26,000 ICT jobs and cumulative digital economic impact.
Qatar commits to ethical, transparent, human-centred AI aligned with international law.
